quote.text: Gustavo Solivellas dice: "Make the best use of what's in your power and take the rest as it happens" (Epictetus)
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Embrace the virtues you can cultivate in your children—patience, kindness, and resilience—and recognize that while you shape their early growth, you cannot control every choice they make as they mature.
    • Focus on guiding them with wisdom and compassion, accepting that life's uncertainties will offer lessons neither you nor they can predict.
  • Leadership:
    • As a leader, concentrate on your sphere of influence: make decisions that reinforce your values and strategic vision, knowing that not all outcomes are within your control.
    • Adopt a calm acceptance of unforeseen challenges, using them as opportunities to demonstrate resilience and inspire confidence in your team.
  • Product Management:
    • Focus diligently on areas where your expertise and effort can effect change—refine your strategy, improve processes, and empower your team to drive innovation.
    • Recognize that market dynamics and external factors will always be partly unpredictable; instead, build flexibility into your plans and learn from unexpected outcomes.
